seo.title: Lemonade: AI-driven underwriting and claims - LAE ratio ~4% (2025)
seo.meta_description: Maya underwrites in 90s, AI Jim settles 55% of claims without a human. AI automation pulls Lemonade's LAE ratio toward ~4%.
seo.resume_citable: By the end of 2025, Lemonade's AI agents (Maya for underwriting, AI Jim for claims) handle about 96% of first notices of loss without a human and automate about 55% of cases, pulling the LAE ratio toward ~4% versus 13% three years earlier.

faq.q: What do Maya and AI Jim do at Lemonade?
faq.a: Maya handles conversational underwriting and generates a priced quote in under 90 seconds; AI Jim takes claim reports and settles about 55% of cases end to end without human intervention.

faq.q: What is the economic impact of this automation?
faq.a: Lemonade cites an LAE ratio of about 4% for the AI-driven portion and an overall LAE ratio that fell from 13% to 7% in three years, while claim volume grew by more than 2.5 times.

objectif_business: Reduce the cost of claims management and refine risk pricing by automating underwriting and claims handling, in order to hold management ratios far below those of traditional insurers with a smaller headcount.
description: Lemonade runs two AI agents. Maya handles conversational underwriting: it recommends coverage, generates a personalized quote, and collects payment in under 90 seconds, backed by the customer cortex, a machine learning system that estimates risk and price in real time. AI Jim handles claims: it takes the first notice of loss and resolves part of the cases end to end, without human intervention. As of the end of 2025, the company states that about 96% of first notices of loss are taken by AI without human intervention and that about 55% of claims are fully automated. This automation pulls the LAE ratio down: Lemonade cites an LAE ratio of about 4% for the AI-driven portion, and an overall LAE ratio that fell from 13% to 7% in three years, while claim volume grew by more than 2.5 times.
points_cles: AI-driven underwriting and claims management through Maya and AI Jim.
In-house platform with customer cortex, risk machine learning, and pricing.
About 96% of loss notices taken without a human, 55% automated.
LAE ratio pulled toward about 4%, evidence level A confirmed.

resultats.metrique: LAE ratio (claims management cost) driven by AI automation
Customers with continuous telemetry feeding real-time pricing

niveau_preuve.justification: Figures published in Lemonade's shareholder letters (filed as 8-K with the SEC) and echoed by the business press. Primary source of financial results, with several concordant quarters on the automation trajectory.

stack_technique.detail: in-house conversational agent that recommends coverage, generates the quote, and collects payment in under 90 seconds
takes about 96% of first notices of loss in chat and settles about 55% of cases end to end
Lemonade's proprietary machine learning system that estimates risk and price in real time; exact models not published
more than 90% of customers equipped; feeds real-time pricing and model retraining

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real time at every interaction (quote or claim), continuous retraining of the risk models as cases resolve.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Lemonade's data science and insurance teams; the AI agents (Maya, AI Jim) hold the front line, humans handle the non-automated cases.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: Risk data and the outcome of past claims. If the quality of claim labels degrades, pricing and automation become less reliable.

etapes.detail: Maya converses with the prospect, estimates risk through the customer cortex, and generates a quote paid in under 90 seconds.
AI Jim takes the first notice of loss in chat and collects the information.
For about 55% of cases, AI Jim verifies and settles the claim end to end, without a human.
Complex or suspicious cases go to a human handler.

prerequis_data: History of claims with outcome and cost
prerequis_orga: Actuarial function to validate the pricing models
Compliance framework for automated decision-making (GDPR, AI Act)
stack_possible: Conversational AI + rules engine + actuarial model
insurtech solutions for automated claims management
replication.premiere_etape: Automate the first notice of loss first (information intake in chat) before aiming for end-to-end settlement.

playbook.action: Frame the data: history of claims with outcome and cost, underwriting data, mapping of automatable cases
playbook.livrable: Labeled dataset + list of claim types that are candidates for automation

playbook.action: Automate the first notice of loss: a conversational agent collects the information, the human keeps the settlement
playbook.livrable: Claim report chat in production, AI intake rate measured

playbook.action: Build the risk scoring and automatic settlement rules on simple cases, with actuarial validation
playbook.livrable: Model validated by the actuarial function + documented GDPR/AI Act compliance framework (oversight, contestation)

playbook.action: Open end-to-end settlement on a limited scope (small claims, low fraud risk), with systematic human escalation on doubtful cases
playbook.livrable: Share of cases settled without a human measured + working escalation path

playbook.action: Extend claim type by claim type and track the economic effect
playbook.livrable: LAE ratio / automation rate dashboard compared to the reference period

replication.equipe: 2-4 data scientists + 1 actuary + 1 PM + claims team for escalations, with compliance/DPO on an ongoing basis

statut_vivant.note: AI automation is at the heart of the Lemonade model and is documented in the most recent shareholder letters (Q3 2025 and later), with metrics improving.

transposable_ue.note: Lemonade already operates in the EU (Germany, Netherlands, France). AI-driven underwriting and pricing constitute automated decision-making under GDPR (art. 22) and are classified as high risk by the AI Act for insurance: human oversight, explainability, and a right to contest are mandatory.
